correctness.rationale: For 1<t<3 the 14 facet-intersection tests in the ordered positive-normal chamber determine N_t exactly. At t=2, 8 sides for every generic normal. For t=2-ε, only bands x-y<εx (loss two sides) and y-z<εy (gain two) contribute first order; at 2+δ the corresponding bands x-y<δz and y-z<δx contribute opposite changes, with simultaneous/axis exceptional sets O(δ²). Tie-set spherical coarea in one of 48 chambers yields the exact coefficients 2√3/π, (6-2√3)/π, 4√3/π, (6√2-4√3)/π, and octagon slopes 6/π and 6√2/π. Open normal chambers of non-octagons for t≠2 establish uniqueness. I independently enumerated actual facet crossings for 30,000 Gaussian Haar normals at each t=1.99,2,2.01, giving 8-sided counts 29427,30000,29207 and side counts consistent with first-order rates; Monte Carlo is finite corroboration, not the cusp proof.
